description: This file implements a tracing system for Playwright, including starting/stopping trace chunks, capturing events, snapshots, resources, and managing trace files and directories. It integrates with browser contexts, pages, and various utilities to record detailed trace data for debugging and analysis.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: A class that manages tracing sessions, capturing events, snapshots, resources, and handling trace file lifecycle within a browser context or API request context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new tracing session with specified options.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk, setting up event listeners and trace files.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the current tracing session and finalizes trace files.

methods.name: deleteTmpTracesDir
methods.description: Removes temporary traces directory if used.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Stops the snapshotter and tracer without finalizing files.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Aborts ongoing tracing and flushes file operations.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new trace group with a specified name and location.

methods.name: groupEnd
methods.description: Ends the current trace group.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally archiving or discarding it, and returns trace artifacts or entries.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handles pre-call instrumentation, capturing trace events and snapshots.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Handles pre-input action instrumentation.

methods.name: onCallLog
methods.description: Logs call-related trace events.

methods.name: onAfterCall
methods.description: Handles post-call instrumentation, capturing trace events and snapshots.

methods.name: onEntryStarted
methods.description: Records the start of a HAR entry.

methods.name: onEntryFinished
methods.description: Records the completion of a HAR entry and appends it to the trace.

methods.name: flushHarEntries
methods.description: Flushes all pending HAR entries into the trace file.

methods.name: onContentBlob
methods.description: Handles content blob data for resources.

methods.name: onSnapshotterBlob
methods.description: Handles snapshotter blob data for resources.

methods.name: onFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Records a frame snapshot event.

methods.name: _onConsoleMessage
methods.description: Records console messages into the trace.

methods.name: onDialog
methods.description: Records dialog events.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Records download events.

methods.name: onPageOpen
methods.description: Records page open events.

methods.name: onPageClose
methods.description: Records page close events.

methods.name: _onPageError
methods.description: Records page error events.

methods.name: _startScreencastInPage
methods.description: Starts screencast recording for a page.

methods.name: _appendTraceEvent
methods.description: Appends a trace event to the trace file.

methods.name: _appendResource
methods.description: Stores resource data associated with a SHA1 hash.
